# Flutter String Extractor

> flutter_string_extractor is a Dart CLI and library for extracting static
> Flutter localization strings and keys into a JSON dictionary.

## Package facts

- Package name: flutter_string_extractor. Command: flutter_string_extractor.
- Version 3.0.0 requires Dart 3.13 or later. Version 2.1.0 supports Dart 3.9+.
  Flutter is not required to run the extractor.
- License: MIT. Default extraction runs locally without an AI model or API key.
- Typical uses: collecting translation keys, reviewing hardcoded Flutter text,
  and exporting messages from one source-locale ARB catalog to JSON.
- Supports GetX, Easy Localization, Flutter Translate,
  FlutterI18n, i18n_extension, static Intl.message, and custom wrapper names.
- Generated AppLocalizations and S.of(context) messages require --from-arb.
- Existing translations are preserved unless --replace is supplied.
- --dry-run previews JSON; --all-strings discovers unmarked static literals.
- Source code is not rewritten. Dynamic keys and interpolated messages cannot
  be resolved; ICU catalogs are imported intact instead of evaluated.
- Optional AI mode in version 2.1.0 finds unmarked user-facing static text
  and translates missing entries into requested locale JSON files. Select
  --ai-provider openai|claude|gemini, --languages de,fr, and --accept-ai.
- AI keys come from OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or GEMINI_API_KEY. --model
  overrides the low-cost default. No provider SDK is required.
- AI --dry-run is local only: candidates are previewed without network or writes.
- AI mode shares candidate strings with the chosen provider and can incur API
  charges. Review AI selection and translations; secret filtering is best effort.
- AI does not rewrite widgets or translate runtime expressions or complex ICU
  plural/select messages. Existing translations are retained, even placeholders;
  delete target entries explicitly if they need AI translation again.

## Context-aware translation and local models in 3.0.0

- Context-aware prompts use bounded source/UI hints, translation IDs and ARB
  descriptions. --context adds app-domain, audience and terminology guidance.
- Source context is included in preview and provider requests; it may be private.
- --ai-provider local uses loopback OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions APIs
  (Ollama, LM Studio or vLLM). --model must name an installed/loaded model.
- --ai-base-url overrides the local API base; --ai-timeout overrides request
  deadlines. LOCAL_AI_API_KEY is optional; cloud keys are never reused locally.
- No model downloads or cloud fallback. Configure the server itself for offline
  execution. Semantic accuracy still requires human review.
- Install or update the published 3.0.0 CLI with Dart 3.13 or later to use
  these options. Version 2.1.0 does not support local models or context hints.
